  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Spanish nevada < nevar “to snow” + -ada, a noun of action/result; literally “a snowfall, snow-covered state”",
    "reading": "A descent of snow; whitened, veiled, made silent by falling white.",
    "languages": ["es", "la"],
    "source": "Real Academia Española, Diccionario de la lengua española; Corominas & Pascual, Diccionario crítico etimológico castellano e hispánico",
    "confidence": 0.98
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "ne- + va- + da; ne as negation, va from va! “go!”, da from da! “give!”",
    "reading": "Not-go, not-give: a refusal that halts movement and withholds the gift.",
    "languages": ["fr", "es", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.56
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "ne + va + da ≈ French nez va d’... / ne va pas d’...; sound suggests “does not go”",
    "reading": "A thing that does not proceed, a suspended passage, an arrested advance.",
    "languages": ["fr", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.49
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "nevada ≈ Latin nivea / nivalis by sound and sense; niv- evokes nix, nivis “snow”",
    "reading": "Snow-white, belonging to snow, a whitening that covers and transforms.",
    "languages": ["la", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.61
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "NEVADA → AVANED / AVENAD / VANADE; the core visible letters V-A-D suggest vad- “to go” with an initial negating N/E",
    "reading": "A road crossed by negation: movement present, yet blocked or reversed.",
    "languages": ["en", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.34
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "N-E-V-A-D-A read as initials: N = no, E = entry, V = veil, A = and, D = descent, A = ash/after",
    "reading": "No entry, veil, descent, ash: a formula of closure and whitening after fall.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.28
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "N as negation; V as valley/valence/opening; A as alpha, beginning; D as door or delta, threshold",
    "reading": "Negation opens a threshold: beginning passes through a gate into a lower basin.",
    "languages": ["en", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.42
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "Using Latin alphabet positions: N14 + E5 + V22 + A1 + D4 + A1 = 47; 4+7 = 11, then 1+1 = 2",
    "reading": "Twofoldness: a split, a pair, a mirrored state after reduction.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.31
  }
]
